name: ui-vault
description: Open-source UI that looks 10x better — curated library, live snippets, Post-FX lab, logo forge

paragraphs: → Quick start · Library · Index · Themes (87) · Elements (273) · Test page · Python & C++ · Docs · Download .zip

A curated vault of open-source UI resources: component kits, copy-paste blocks, motion, effects, post-processing, 3D, icons, logos, fonts, color, charts and native/game UI. It also has live, copy-ready snippets.
features: Themes (themes.html): 87 complete design styles (12 core + 50 regular + 25 signature, e.g. pearl, sapphire-metal, fade, doppler, case-hardened) covering buttons, headings, cards, hover motion and backgrounds; gallery…

Elements (elements.html) and Test page (lab.html): 273 element designs in 15 families, picked per family with data-uv-="name" on or any element (nearest wins), plus 18 kits (a theme + one design per family). Generated…

Library (library.html): every element, loader, animation, background, effect, theme, kit, component, block and native widget, shown live. Add items to a package. The tray shows web/Python/C++ code, and the Quick start…
Index (directory.html): search over everything (generated lib/catalog.js). The top bar on every page is Home · Quick start · Index.

Effect layers (lib/js/layers.js, tools/layersspecs.py): glow, shadow, border, backdrop, fill, shape, text, hover, press, entrance, idle, every uv-fx effect and page effects, on any element type or one element. Set them…
